## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Kaṇhapetavatthu* (Pv 18), translated in English as *King Kaṇha*, is a canonical text in the *Petavatthu* [SuttaCentral]. The narrative addresses the question of how to reflect rightly in order to overcome grief [SuttaCentral].
SuttaCentral identifies a passage-level parallel between the text and the *Cūḷarathavimānavatthu* (Vv 63), an alignment corroborated by DharmaNexus, which records shared material between segments 11.4–15.4 of Pv 18 and 15.1–18.4 of Vv 63 [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral also notes close connections with a cluster of grief-consolation discourses and stories, including the *Goṇapetavatthu* (Pv 8), *Maṭṭhakuṇḍalīpetavatthu* (Pv 17), *Ubbaripetavatthu* (Pv 25), *Maṭṭhakuṇḍalīvimānavatthu* (Vv 83), *Sujātajātaka* (Ja 352), *Migapotakajātaka* (Ja 372), *Somadattajātaka* (Ja 410), *Maṭṭhakuṇḍalījātaka* (Ja 449), and *Ghaṭapaṇḍitajātaka* (Ja 454) [SuttaCentral].
This network of relationships is borne out by DharmaNexus machine alignments showing extensive Pali-internal text reuse across these works [DharmaNexus]. In particular, Pv 18 shares its major opening narrative sequence (§0.3–10.4) with the *Ghaṭapaṇḍitajātaka* (Ja 454), while standard grief-dispelling verses (§16.1–18.4 or 19.3) recur verbatim or nearly verbatim in Pv 8, Pv 17, Ja 352, Ja 372, Ja 410, Ja 449, and Vv 83 [DharmaNexus]. Substantial matches also connect Pv 18 to its commentary in the *Petavatthu-aṭṭhakathā*, as well as the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā*, *Vimānavatthu-aṭṭhakathā*, and *Dhammapada-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches are reported in DharmaNexus [DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral lists four translations of the text in four modern languages [SuttaCentral].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
